shots.what: rock cut, Gage leans over the drill hole packing powder with the iron, both fists on it; grit puffs, a small spark, the big spark
shots.motion_source: procedural tamp cycle + per frame arm solve onto the iron
shots.notes: hands solved onto the iron every frame (error under 2 px); iron moves only with his push; trees sway, clouds drift, motes; slow push in; upper right calm for the poll sticker

shots.what: blast: flash and smoke, iron driven up out of the hole tapered end first, he is thrown back, hat knocked off; camera follows the iron into the sky as it turns over
shots.motion_source: procedural ballistics (blast drives the iron; gravity after)
shots.notes: the instant the iron passes his head is inside the flash; smoke as swelling soft puffs; chips under gravity; blast sound only

shots.what: low view at the landing spot: the iron comes down point first, sticks, dust; Gage lies far up the cut by the smoking hole
shots.notes: perspective rock cut with blasted faces, drill grooves, scrub on top; push up the cut into a zoom cut

shots.what: he lies on his back, workers run in, he sits up propped on his hands, a worker bends with his hand on his shoulder; he talks
shots.motion_source: procedural keys + per frame arm solve (hands planted, hand on shoulder); run cycle with stride matched to travel
shots.notes: hat lies on the rock behind him; smoke drifting; motes

shots.what: continuous push to his head; x ray of his head only (no hat on him); ghost iron replays the path; left frontal lobe lights; chips on their words
shots.notes: skull: vault, orbit, nasal opening, zygomatic arch, maxilla, mandible, incisors to molars, cervical vertebrae; brain with gyri, central and lateral sulci, temporal lobe, cerebellum, brainstem; iron width to scale; worker hand stays on his shoulder (dimmed)

shots.what: before: Gage points the crew to the next drill spot, rolled plan in his fist; the contractor behind him, hand on his shoulder, nods on capable
shots.notes: background crew drilling: holder grips the steel, hammer with both hands on the handle

shots.what: after (grey day, scar, shut left eye): he jabs a finger and snaps; turns away from the offered open hand; drops the plan, which falls fluttering and lies on the rock
shots.motion_source: procedural keys; paper under gravity with flutter
shots.notes: the plan leaves from his hand only when he opens it

shots.what: dusk: Gage walks off left, feet planted, stride matched; two friends watch
shots.notes: lantern flicker, clouds; end line over the last 1.5 s
